title: Solitaire Suite
description: Three classic patience games in one deck: Klondike (draw 1 or 3), Spider (1, 2 or 4 suits) and FreeCell. Seeded deals you can replay or share, unlimited undo, smart hints, one-press auto-finish, per-variant records and a twelve-stage Gauntlet of timed and undo-limited challenges.

achievements.title: Klondike Solved
achievements.desc: Win your first game of Klondike.

achievements.title: Speed Demon
achievements.desc: Win any deal in under four minutes.

achievements.title: On a Heater
achievements.desc: Win three deals in a row in the same game.

achievements.title: Iron Will
achievements.desc: Win a deal without using a single undo.

achievements.title: Suite Master
achievements.desc: Win all three variants: Klondike, Spider and FreeCell.
